verdict.rationale: Session transcripts are written to disk automatically and a SessionStore adapter lets developers mirror those transcripts to their own backend (object store, KV store, database), giving users control over their conversation data and the ability to move it elsewhere. However, there's no explicit documentation of a full 'export all data' feature, no stated open/standard file format for transcripts, and no mention of exporting other data types (configs, custom tools, permissions settings). missing for 10: documented open export format for session data, a full account/data export feature, evidence covering all data types beyond session transcripts.
